title: OneCoin signup
description: How to sign up new member into OneCoin binary network.

asr.full_text: today we look how we can join new member into one coin network from our back-office first we have to log in to your own back-office and the backoffice who So, what we can see here. At first, there is a notice that that transaction password has not been set. This is a password that is needed to transfer money out from a system. Making gift codes or transferring money to other members on the downline. At the current moment, if you want to register a new member, this function is not important, so we will skip this at the current moment. There are two ways to register a new member and a success always. If you can do it personally, you do it personally. The other way is to send out link link, Personal Sponsoring Link, and anybody from around the world can use your Sponsoring Link and sign up in your network. The Sponsoring Link is here under Proifle, you just copy it and send it to anybody, who wishes to join. Before you send your link, you should save your settings for your new member. As we have a binary system, we have two leg's, left and right. I always suggest to keep your track, whether you are signing a new member member on left or right side. if you do it with the inviting link, it joins to your inner leg not to your sponsor leg. This is my preferred setting. At the current moment we have sponsor leg right, that is why we have set already saving for left, so it means that every time new person joins with a sponsoring link, he will be automatically put into your inner leg. Of course you can do it other ways and there is a way to use alternatively left-right, which means the system automatically joins members depending of the balance you have. But I don't successfully use it because you don't have a control who will be joining which team. Which is not good for the future cooperation. So ... I suggest that you always save for the future, the best placement that you think will be, the you can always of course change it, But if you want to join a member yourself, that's the best way to do, you go to my network, then you see You can always choose whether you join new member left or right because this is binary. At this moment the sponsor leg is right so it means the sponsor is left here and the strongest leg, sponsor leg goes right and continues through this direction. So, you just choose this icon click on it and you can start filling out the details for the new member And at the current moment the Sponsor wants a new member to be placed in the Power-Leg. so that's why we choose the right one And we start to fill up on details and when the details are filled up name last name user name email preferably gmail but it can also be any an email that you can use ,password must consist 8 digits...at least one capital letter one small letter and one number ... you confirm password twice you select your country and well of course the country where you live. And then it's done. Just add your mobile phone number, and if you want to be registered as a corporate client, you can click here. If not, don't touch it. Just add an member, and that's it. You will be placed into your binary system without any payment at the first moment. And the new member can receive a welcome letter within the next 15 days to keep your saved position. The new member will receive a welcome letter. Actually two welcome letters The first one which asks you to confirm your email Please just click to this link! To verify email and and the registration is complete. So I will continue to fill up the user data and this will be of course done secretly.

visual.observation: A branded landing page describes OneCoin as “the next Bitcoin” and displays a “Become A Member” option alongside an “Already joined” area.

visual.limitations: The frame does not show a specific return amount, guarantee, price, payment instruction, or membership outcome.

visual.observation: The account dashboard states that a transaction password is needed to buy or sell tokens and make withdrawals. A separate notice says the account is pending because payment for activation or a product package has not been registered and refers to a normal 3–5 working-day payment-registration period.
visual.context: Logged-in account dashboard with payment-status and transaction-password notices.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface links account activation or product access to payment and links a requested transaction credential to token purchases, sales, and withdrawals.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish that a payment was made, that a password was submitted, or that any transaction or withdrawal occurred.

visual.observation: The profile page shows an invite link and the instruction “Click here to sign up a new member with you as a sponsor,” with left/right placement choices. The account interface also contains bonus-related fields, including “Bonus earned this month” and “Total bonus earned.”
visual.context: Branded member-account interface showing sponsorship, network placement, and bonus categories.
visual.potential_relevance: An explicit member-recruitment and sponsorship step is presented within an account structure that tracks bonus-related amounts, linking recruitment activity to displayed benefit categories.
visual.limitations: The frames do not state how bonuses are calculated, whether they are guaranteed, or whether the invite was used.

visual.observation: An “Add member” form visibly requests account and contact information including username, email and confirmation email, password and confirmation password, country, and mobile phone, with an option to accept terms and privacy policy.
visual.context: The form appears within the “My Network” member-management area.
visual.potential_relevance: The sponsorship or network-management flow combines adding another member with collection of contact details, account credentials, and phone/country information.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show who submitted the form, whether the information was valid, or how the information was used.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to recruit new members into a binary network using a sponsoring link and to place recruits in left or right downline legs. The dashboard also displays leadership rank, bonus, and sponsored-member metrics, showing that the tutorial facilitates recruitment-dependent participation rather than reporting on or criticizing the scheme.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video presents a multi-person binary hierarchy with sponsor/downline placement and operational instructions for adding new members through a personal sponsoring link, alongside account metrics tied to sponsorship and bonuses.
